metadata.title: Research data supporting "Exponential Scaling Barriers for Variational Quantum Eigensolvers"
metadata.description:
This data contains additional information on the molecules in the MolVQE-21 benchmark dataset. Further it contains the energy, spin and gradient information for the ADAPT-VQE runs in each ADAPT iteration, which are necessary to generate the figures in "Exponential Scaling Barriers for Variational Quantum Eigensolvers". The file data_format.txt contains additional information about the data structure.
This work was supported by the German Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space through the project H2Giga-DegradEL3 (grant no. 03HY110D).
